Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
The Meridian Pacing System is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5 T when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Maximum gradient slew rate of 100 T/m/s per axis.
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode.
- Body transmit coil or head transmit coil.
- Use CP mode only (circularly polarized RF excitation).
- B1+rms ≤ 3.6 µT.
- Scan for up to 60 minutes.
- Wait 15 minutes before the next imaging session.
Before scanning, set the device configuration: Stimulation OFF.
